english_text: Capture the enemy base, or kill all enemy forces!
czech_text: Obsaďte jejich základnu, nebo zničte všechny nepřátele!

english_text: I will do what must be done.
My enemies will know me and despair.
czech_text: Mí nepřátelé mě poznají a propadnou zoufalství.

english_text: Our allies are firing on us!
Our ally is suffering friendly fire!
czech_text: Náš spojenec je pod naší palbou!

english_text: Raise the eagle! Cynane has fallen!
The battle draws to a close!
The enemy base will soon be ours!
The enemy has drawn first blood!
The true battle is just beginning!
